summary: Nearfield now plays as loud as a single Studio Display at the same volume.
The displays keep their full bass at lower volumes.
changes: Includes audio driver 1.2.0. Nearfield now uses the Studio Displays' own volume curve, so it plays as loud as a single display at the same volume; earlier drivers played up to 16 dB quieter.
The displays keep their full bass at lower volumes: their own volume now follows Nearfield's instead of staying at maximum, so their built-in bass compensation works as it does on a single display.
Updating the driver keeps your current loudness; the volume slider moves to match the new curve.
While Nearfield is active, an app playing directly on a Studio Display follows Nearfield's volume.
